Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to the questions we hear most from UAE enterprises exploring technology partnerships.

Are you an authorised partner for the hardware and software you deploy?
Yes. We are authorised partners for Dell Technologies, HPE, Cisco, Pure Storage, NVIDIA, and NetApp — among others. We procure exclusively through authorised distribution channels, ensuring genuine products, valid manufacturer warranties, and full UAE in-country support. We do not source grey-market hardware.
Can you deploy IT infrastructure in air-gapped or classified environments?
Yes. Our team has extensive hands-on experience deploying complex IT infrastructure — including multi-node GPU clusters and large-scale storage — in fully air-gapped, dark-site, and classified environments. We understand the specialized security protocols, physical logistics, and audit documentation these projects require.
What are your typical hardware deployment timelines?
Timelines depend on project scale. A straightforward rack server deployment with standard configuration can be completed in 3–5 business days from procurement. Complex multi-node environments — including structured cabling, firmware baselining, OS configuration, and hypervisor clustering — typically take 2–4 weeks. We provide a detailed project schedule with milestones at proposal stage.
Do you offer Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)?
Yes. We provide structured AMC packages covering preventive maintenance, firmware and patch management, break-fix support, loaner hardware provision, and SLA-backed response times (1-hour emergency, 4-hour on-site, next business day, or custom 24/7/365). AMCs can be tailored to cover specific equipment or your entire IT estate.
What is the difference between EDR and XDR?
EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) focuses specifically on protecting endpoints — laptops, desktops, and servers — using behavioural analysis, threat hunting, and MITRE ATT&CK-aligned detection. XDR (Extended Detection and Response) goes further by correlating telemetry across endpoints, the network, email, identity, and cloud — giving your security team a unified view of threats across the entire environment. We assess your environment and recommend the right level of coverage.
Can you help with UAE PDPL and regional compliance?
Yes. We have deep familiarity with the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021), the DIFC Data Protection Law No. 5 of 2020 (as amended by Law No. 1 of 2025), ADGM Data Protection Regulations 2021, and GDPR. We help organisations map their data flows, identify compliance gaps, and implement both technical controls and procedural frameworks to meet their obligations.
What is ERPNext and how does it compare to SAP or Dynamics?
ERPNext is a fully open-source ERP platform built on the Frappe framework. It covers accounting, HR, payroll, inventory, manufacturing, CRM, and project management in one unified system. Unlike SAP or Microsoft Dynamics, ERPNext has zero per-user licensing fees — you pay only for implementation, customisation, and hosting. It is an ideal choice for UAE mid-market enterprises that need full functionality without recurrent six-figure annual licensing fees.
How does the Digital Business Card solution work?
Our Digital Business Card replaces printed paper with a smart NFC-enabled card and QR code that instantly shares your full professional profile. With one tap, contacts can add your pass directly to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, or save your vCard directly to their contacts. Your details are managed through an online dashboard, so updates to phone numbers or titles reflect across everyone's saved passes immediately.
What size of organisation do you typically serve?
We serve organisations from 50 to 5,000+ employees across government, banking, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, logistics, and education. Solutions are always right-sized to match your actual requirements — we do not upsell bloated enterprise suites to businesses that do not need them.
How quickly can you respond to an RFP / RFQ?
We acknowledge all enquiries within 24 hours and typically deliver a scoped proposal with a detailed Bill of Materials (BOM) within 3–5 business days. For urgent requirements, call our direct engineering line at +971 6 746 4596 or +971 50 348 8680.
